title: Navisworks Output Types and Governance Classification

entries.name: Navisworks NWF Working Coordination Container
entries.classification_rule: Treat as working coordination information unless a project-specific exchange requirement explicitly declares the NWF itself as an issued deliverable.
entries.record_rule: Working-file existence alone does not make the NWF a project record.

entries.name: Navisworks NWD Published Coordination Snapshot
entries.classification_rule: An NWD becomes a governed deliverable only when intentionally issued through the applicable S7 exchange process with declared purpose, scope, state, permitted use, and traceable issue record.
entries.record_rule: Record status depends on the project records/retention rule and declared milestone purpose, not on the NWD format itself.

entries.name: Navisworks Clash Report
entries.classification_rule: A clash report may serve as working evidence or a formally issued deliverable depending on the declared coordination gate or exchange requirement.
entries.record_rule: Retain as governed evidence when it supports a recorded coordination gate, sign-off, acceptance decision, or required project record.

entries.name: Navisworks Viewpoint Set
entries.classification_rule: Viewpoints are review evidence unless explicitly packaged and issued as part of a governed exchange.
entries.record_rule: Viewpoint evidence must remain traceable to the reviewed model versions and applicable issue or review cycle when retained.

entries.name: Navisworks Screenshot or Markup
entries.classification_rule: Screenshots and markups may support communication or evidence but do not replace the governed issue, review, or acceptance record when such a record is required.
entries.record_rule: Retain only when needed to support a governed issue, review, decision, or exchange.

entries.name: BCF or Governed Issue-System Export
entries.classification_rule: An issue export is a representation of issue data and does not become the authoritative issue system merely because it is generated or distributed.
entries.record_rule: Authoritative status remains with the project-designated issue system of record unless project governance explicitly declares otherwise.

governance_rules: Navisworks file format does not by itself establish formal exchange, deliverable, record, acceptance, or reliance status.
Formal issue, acceptance, and sign-off evidence shall remain traceable to the project-designated governed system of record.

Project-specific folder paths, retention durations, exact packaging rules, and client-specific deliverable requirements shall be defined by the applicable BEP, exchange requirements, CDE rules, and records schedule.

provenance.migration_note: The source identifies NWF, NWD, clash reports, viewpoint sets, screenshots, and issue exports but leaves several deliverable/record classifications as TODO. This registry therefore preserves the source object taxonomy while deriving status rules from existing governed S7/S5 doctrine rather than promoting unresolved draft examples, folder paths, or retention assumptions.
